label: The War Within
present: The world is Azeroth in the Worldsoul Saga, with Khaz Algar's deeps opened, the Void's Harbinger plotting and the world's own soul at stake.
world: Under the world, Khaz Algar: the Isle of Dorn and Dornogal, the Ringing Deeps, Hallowfall's Light-fed lands and the nerubian realm of Azj-Kahet. Xal'atath, the Harbinger of the Void, corrupts the nerubians, destroys Dalaran and seeks the Worldsoul. Alliance and Horde keep an armistice, with the Earthen of Dornogal as new friends. Housing neighbourhoods rise at Founder's Point.
idiom: Folk swear by the Light, the Loa and the Earthen's Titans; coin is gold, silver and copper; delvers go into delves; Resonance Crystals pay in Khaz Algar.

folk.alliance: You know of the Harbinger, Dalaran's fall and the Earthen's welcome; the Horde keeps an armistice.
folk.horde: You know of the Harbinger, Dalaran's fall and the Earthen's welcome; the Alliance keeps an armistice.
folk.neutral: You hear dark news of the Void and trade in Khaz Algar's deeps.
